title: Kazoos by Jazzish
description: Ever wanted your goat horns to be kazoos? No? Well here they are anyway!
body:
##           Kazoos by Jazzish!

**I hope you enjoy the silly instruments!**

This pack turns every goat horn into it's own little kazoo song!

I can't guarantee the sounds won't cause DMCA strikes if making content with them- it's just me tooting into my kazoo, but they are covers of existing songs.

![Jazzish holds her kazoo proudly](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d3f4bc81138f4486fdab75733824ca2c7b843b6_0.webp)

Songs included:

- **All Star** - Smash Mouth
- **Careless Whisper** - George Michael
- **Jurassic Park Theme** - John Williams
- **Megalovania** - Toby Fox
- **My Heart Will Go On** - Céline Dion
- **Never Gonna Give You Up** - Rick Astley
- **Shooting Stars** - Bag Raiders
- **The Final Countdown** - Europe

Everything in this pack is made by me! <3
